trigger: Ambient: the singer in the ration line.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A man in a gold sequined jacket is singing Sinatra to the ration line. Badly. Beautifully.

nodes.speaker: amb_lonnie
nodes.text: Thank you, thank you. Lonnie Vance, Silver Spur lounge, Tuesdays and Thursdays. Well. Formerly.

nodes.speaker: amb_lonnie
nodes.text: I take requests. I also take crackers. The crackers are not optional.

nodes.speaker: amb_lonnie
nodes.text: Sir, you are a patron of the arts. This one's for you and the wolf.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He sings 'Fly Me to the Moon.' A kid in line starts crying. Then laughing. The line moves a foot.

nodes.speaker: amb_lonnie
nodes.text: No? No. That's fair. Nobody's got crackers. I'll sing anyway. Union rules.

nodes.speaker: amb_brother_amos
nodes.text: Nineteen days! Two hundred and six dead in this county that I know of! I'm counting! Somebody has to count!
